# InSituPy Sample Datasets (insitupy.datasets)

Sample datasets are provided for tutorials, testing, and exploration.
They are downloaded on first call and cached locally.

## Available Datasets

  list_downloaded_datasets(output_dir=None)
    List all downloaded demo datasets in a directory.
  visium_human_breast_cancer(overwrite: bool = False, download_fullres: bool = False, output_dir=None) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData
    Load human FFPE breast cancer CytAssist Visium data (v2.0.0, ~3000 spots, 10x Genomics).
  xenium_human_brain_cancer(overwrite: bool = False, output_dir=None) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData
    Load human FFPE GBM brain cancer Xenium data (v2.0.0, immuno-oncology profiling panel, 10x Genomics).
  xenium_human_breast_cancer(overwrite: bool = False, output_dir=None) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData
    Load human FFPE breast cancer Xenium data (v1.0.1, ~160k cells, 10x Genomics preview dataset).
  xenium_human_kidney_nondiseased(overwrite: bool = False, output_dir=None) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData
    Load human non-diseased FFPE kidney Xenium data (v1.5.0, 10x Genomics multi-tissue and cancer panel).
  xenium_human_lung_cancer(overwrite: bool = False, output_dir=None) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData
    Load human FFPE lung cancer Xenium data (v2.0.0, multimodal cell segmentation, 10x Genomics).
  xenium_human_lymph_node(overwrite: bool = False, output_dir=None) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData
    Load human non-diseased FFPE lymph node Xenium data (v1.5.0, multi-tissue and cancer panel, 10x Genomics).
  xenium_human_lymph_node_5k(overwrite: bool = False, output_dir=None) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData
    Load human reactive FFPE lymph node Xenium Prime data (v3.0.0, 5k gene panel, 10x Genomics).
  xenium_human_pancreatic_cancer(overwrite: bool = False, output_dir=None) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData
    Load human FFPE pancreatic cancer Xenium data (v1.6.0, add-on panel, 10x Genomics).
  xenium_human_skin_melanoma(overwrite: bool = False, output_dir=None) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData
    Load human FFPE skin melanoma Xenium data (v1.7.0, skin gene expression panel, 10x Genomics).
  xenium_test_dataset(overwrite: bool = False, output_dir=None) -> insitupy._core.data.InSituData

    Load mouse ileum tiny Xenium Prime test data (v3.0.0, multimodal cell segmentation, 10x Genomics).
